properties.description: Private DataForge text-model gateway. Calls require a validated Entra token from the runtime identity.

properties.value: [concat('<policies><inbound><base /><validate-jwt header-name="Authorization" require-scheme="Bearer" failed-validation-httpcode="401" failed-validation-error-message="A valid DataForge runtime token with the required application role is required."><openid-config url="https://login.microsoftonline.com/', parameters('tenantId'), '/.well-known/openid-configuration" /><audiences><audience>', parameters('allowedAudience'), '</audience></audiences><required-claims><claim name="roles" match="any"><value>', parameters('requiredApplicationRole'), '</value></claim></required-claims></validate-jwt><set-variable name="dataforgeCorrelation" value="@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-dataforge-correlation-id", ""))" /><llm-emit-token-metric namespace="DataForge.LLM"><dimension name="API ID" /><dimension name="Gateway ID" /><dimension name="Workspace Hash" value="@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-dataforge-workspace-hash", "unknown"))" /></llm-emit-token-metric><set-header name="x-dataforge-workspace-hash" exists-action="delete" /><set-header name="x-dataforge-run-hash" exists-action="delete" /><set-header name="x-dataforge-actor-hash" exists-action="delete" /><set-header name="x-dataforge-correlation-id" exists-action="delete" /><set-header name="x-dataforge-model-route" exists-action="delete" /><authentication-managed-identity resource="https://cognitiveservices.azure.com" /></inbound><backend><base /></backend><outbound><base /><set-header name="x-dataforge-gateway-correlation" exists-action="override"><value>@((string)context.Variables["dataforgeCorrelation"])</value></set-header></outbound><on-error><base /></on-error></policies>')]
